description.narrative: The purpose of this Initiation Plan is to capitalize on the growing importance of innovative fundraising methods, particularly crowdfunding, in the evolving landscape of international development. Crowdfunding has become a popular alternative to traditional funding, allowing local entrepreneurs, individuals, and community projects, non-profit organizations to receive financial support directly from the public, private sector, and other donor groups. This method not only increases community involvement, particularly women and youth, but also addresses financial exclusion, especially in remote areas where traditional banking services are difficult to access.The expected output of this Initiation Plan is the development and launch of crowdfunding campaigns. These campaigns will utilize online platforms to connect projects with potential donors, thereby promoting a financial system in Angola that supports inclusivity, economic, and social growth. By successfully launching these crowdfunding campaigns, the project aims to secure the resources and support necessary to sustain and expand its impact, ensuring long-term benefits for local communities.
